chronicle.title: Bartholomeu Krauser: guided creation to the 2010 threshold
chronicle.dramatic_engine: A mortal craftsman tries to keep responsibility, family, and self-determination under pressure from hidden systems; after an imposed transformation, survival and status demand compromises whose costs remain his to choose.
chronicle.genre: Personal horror with gothic-punk social pressure, human-scale family stakes, industrial atmosphere, and Cainite political conflict.
design_principles: Consequences travel through observable actions and named channels.
Silence, refusal, flight, failure, and abandonment close local units without being punished by an infinite hook chain.
NPCs pursue independent goals on their own clocks; no NPC knows untransmitted information.
A forced Embrace is a future authorial target, never a reward or an already-played outcome.
No story grants XP, dots, damage, Hunger, Humanity, or state changes automatically.
chronicle.play_preparation: D07 V017 and D08 V017 are the current prospective truth/preparation contracts, each derived from D06 V025 and integrated here. D04 V010 remains unchanged and no C06 cause is admitted. This version aligns local refusal/deferral closure and recoverable divergence with the finite route policy; it does not change canon or create an event. No scene is ready or activated.

finite_progression.scene_queue: Each playable unit has a local closure and a no-contact/abandonment exit. The target route requires admitted causes and authorization. When a cause is absent, keep the route pending/quiet or let the player explicitly select the finite route-level ALTERNATE exit at the latest reconciled checkpoint. No automatic replacement queue, repeated summons, test quota, or all-world resolution is required. The exit creates no story, episode closure, cycle, event, time skip, or 2010 completion.
finite_progression.target_window: Authorial target: forced Embrace after the played C05 checkpoint and before 1970-12-25, only after actual M3.01 closure and an authorized, recorded transition; no exact date. If a played result irreversibly blocks the target, preserve it and open a finite reconciled review; do not assign ALTERNATE/INCOMPLETE automatically or invent a replacement cause.

episode_closure_gate.purpose: Permit a future M3.02 only after the played M3.01 has a finite, player-confirmed and source-reconciled close on the selected route; this does not close M3.01 now.
required_evidence: Identify the selected route. ROUTE-GUIDED-TO-2010 is selectable only after a source-backed cause is admitted in D04 and separately authorized; then ST-C06-REENTRY must actually start and have a recorded outcome, explicit local closure evidence, and reconciled persistence. Until those prerequisites exist, the target route is unavailable and the handoff anchor cannot satisfy its gate. A target-route C06 decline is not treated as completion.

On ROUTE-M3-01-DECLINED-CONTINUATION, record an actually stated C06 decline only if a valid offer was made; otherwise record that D04 V010 contains no admitted C06 cause. In either case the player must separately choose whether to continue or close M3.01. This creates no substitute story or event.
Every story unit actually started in M3.01 has a recorded local outcome and closure evidence; no started unit is silently left open.
Every optional M3.01 story not started is explicitly left quiet/declined rather than treated as mandatory. Any chosen optional continuation uses only its documented entry cause and bounded evidence.
The player explicitly chooses to close M3.01 after reviewing the actual timeline and route outcome; no closure is inferred from labels or elapsed time.
The latest episode source, LIVE, HISTORY_INDEX and character state reconcile at the same event boundary; relevant blob hashes and pending persistence reconcile.

A new highest-numbered CYCLE valid under the current orchestration contract records the authorized transition and next role. Use only fields/statuses supported by that contract; if it has no supported closure/transition representation, stop and keep M3.02 blocked until an authorized contract successor exists.

architecture_notes: Chronicle → structural milestones/acts → stories/provocations → scenes → conditional beats. Marcos 1–5 are structural; Mx.yy are episodes. The target route intends a C06 reentry only if an approved source supplies a cause and D04 admits it. At present ST-C06-REENTRY is a handoff anchor, not a story or scene; a player-chosen alternate closure needs its own evidence gate, and any later contact needs its own existing causal trigger.

preferred_route.rule: The target path keeps all existing entry, relay, attendance, deadline, mechanics, and closure conditions. No particular test result or Embrace is guaranteed; no C06 scene is offered while its causal entry is unadmitted.
preferred_route.entry_gate: ST-C06-REENTRY has no admitted cause in D04 V010 and is not ready. The preferred route may use it only after a source-backed D04 admission and fresh authorization; an orchestration cycle alone does not supply the cause.

finite_alternative_after_c06_decline.entry_condition: Use only after an actually presented C06 offer is declined before start, or after the player separately chooses whether to continue/close M3.01 once the Dramaturgo confirms no admitted C06 cause. Absence of a cause or offer is not a player refusal.
local_continuity: If the player actually declines a valid C06 offer, record only that disposition; do not mark ST-C06-REENTRY as played or complete and do not send a second or renamed summons. If there is no valid offer, record no refusal.

ST-VOLNAYA-BOUNDARY is available only if the player actually chooses to resume the existing paper trail, asks an already known participant, or brings the existing copy; its evidence remains bounded and does not automatically reach any Cainite.
ST-MEASURE-DISPOSITION is available only if its own current request/disposition condition is actually opened; do not manufacture a customer, work order, defect, or follow-up to replace C06.
Any other M3.01 story already started must reach its actual local outcome. Unstarted units may remain quiet/declined.
finite_alternative_after_c06_decline.macro_close: M3.01 may be explicitly closed ALTERNATE after all actually started units have recorded outcomes, source/state reconciliation passes, the player expressly chooses closure, and the orchestration contract records an authorized transition. The refusal itself never closes the episode or starts M3.02.
finite_alternative_after_c06_decline.next_causal_entry: After a valid separate transition, only the already-authored ST-GANGREL-ATTENTION can begin in M3.02, and only if its own D08 V017 entry cause occurs: Rada observes an actual local delivery/interaction, or Bart directly asks her to relay contact and she actually transmits the request. ST-MEASURE-DISPOSITION and ST-VOLNAYA-BOUNDARY remain M3.01 units and cannot open after its closure. These are future conditions, not current events.
finite_alternative_after_c06_decline.quiet_result: If no independent cause, request, or transmission occurs, the Cainite thread stays quiet. A recoverable local refusal/failure/deviation/delay also leaves the route pending/quiet. The player may explicitly select ROUTE-QUIET-ALTERNATE-EXIT at a reconciled checkpoint; absence, refusal, or local closure alone never assigns route ALTERNATE or INCOMPLETE.

irreversible_divergence.rule: Preserve actual death/Final Death, deadline miss, refusal, successful escape, mechanical failure, and other results exactly as played. Recoverable refusal, nonlethal failure, deviation, escape, or delay closes only its local unit and leaves the route pending/quiet. A real irreversible result that materially blocks the target opens a finite, source-reconciled review; no alternative erases it or guarantees transformation. Assign route-level ALTERNATE only after the player explicitly chooses that disposition; assign INCOMPLETE only when reconciled evidence proves a required target is materially blocked and the player selects/disposes the route under D09. Continue only through a materially compatible already-authored cause that actually occurs; invent no replacement thread, summons, rescue, or event.

finite_quiet_exit_without_cause.entry_condition: At the latest reconciled checkpoint, C06 has no admitted cause, or no independent entry cause has occurred for the next target story. The player explicitly chooses to end the guided-creation route without waiting for a new scene.
finite_quiet_exit_without_cause.choice: The player may instead keep the route pending/quiet; no refusal, elapsed time, contact, invitation, or transition is inferred.
finite_quiet_exit_without_cause.finite_result: Record the guided-creation route as ALTERNATE at the latest reconciled checkpoint, list the target-route requirements not met and unresolved questions, and preserve all current state and ledgers. This is a route-level end, not story closure, episode closure, graduation, 2010 review, or CHARACTER_READY.
finite_quiet_exit_without_cause.no_new_fiction: No story, test, time skip, NPC action, cycle, scene, contact, or state change is required or created by this choice. M3.01 remains open unless its separate episode-closure gate is actually satisfied.
finite_quiet_exit_without_cause.resumption: Any later continuation requires a new explicit player choice, real causal entry, current source reconciliation, and applicable operational gates; no repeated or renamed summon.
